title: Macrophage memory emerges from coordinated transcription factor and chromatin dynamics.
authors: Wang, Andrew G; Son, Minjun; Gorin, Aleksandr; Kenna, Emma; Padhi, Abinash; Keisham, Bijentimala; Schauer, Adam; Hoffmann, Alexander; Tay, Savas
one_liner_zh: 该文结合活细胞成像、ATAC-seq和深度学习研究巨噬细胞中NF-kB转录因子与染色质动态协同的免疫记忆，涉及TF-DNA结合与染色质可及性建模，但核心是免疫信号记忆而非TF-DNA互作机制本身，方法可迁移至本课题。
abstract: Cells of the immune system operate in dynamic microenvironments where the timing, concentration, and order of signaling molecules constantly change. Despite this complexity, immune cells manage to communicate accurately and control inflammation and infection. It is unclear how these dynamic signals are encoded and decoded and if individual cells retain the memory of past exposure to inflammatory molecules. Here, we use live-cell analysis, ATAC sequencing, and an in vivo model of sepsis to show that sequential inflammatory signals induce memory in individual macrophages through reprogramming the nuclear factor kappaB (NF-kappaB) network and the chromatin accessibility landscape. We use transcriptomic profiling and deep learning to show that transcription factor and chromatin dynamics coordinate fine-tuned macrophage responses to new inflammatory signals. This work demonstrates how macrophages retain the memory of previous signals despite single-cell variability and elucidates the mechanisms of signal-induced memory in dynamic inflammatory conditions like sepsis.
abstract_zh: 免疫系统的细胞在动态微环境中运作，其中信号分子的时间、浓度和顺序不断变化。尽管存在这种复杂性，免疫细胞仍能准确通信并控制炎症和感染。目前尚不清楚这些动态信号是如何被编码和解码的，以及单个细胞是否保留了对过去炎症分子暴露的记忆。在此，我们利用活细胞分析、ATAC测序和脓毒症体内模型，表明连续的炎症信号通过重编程核因子kappaB（NF-kappaB）网络和染色质可及性景观，在单个巨噬细胞中诱导记忆。我们使用转录组谱分析和深度学习，表明转录因子和染色质动力学协调巨噬细胞对新炎症信号的精细调节反应。这项工作展示了巨噬细胞如何在单细胞变异中保留先前信号的记忆，并阐明了在脓毒症等动态炎症条件下信号诱导记忆的机制。
